title: Kagamine Rin — Pop Out SEKAI〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, isn't it starting pretty soon?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shinonome told us that you'd be joining us today. We hope you'll have a good time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I'm still somewhat surprised that you're actually here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I said they'd be here. It's also easier to just have them see one of these instead of having us explain what we've been doing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Akito, before I forget...!
Thanks for inviting us today!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You asked, so here you are.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But we do hope you get to enjoy yourselves since you are actually here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway, we should head in soon.
Rin, Len, you'll have to stay scarce for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, you can come out now.
This look like a good spot?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. This place is on the small side too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <It is?! But that crowd looks huge!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <That's so cool! I can't wait for everything to start!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And we're gonna really get them going so that you get to see a good show.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But don't mess around too much since the staff might still find you guys.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'll try to hide you behind one of the spare speakers or something.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Thank you for that stellar performance!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <The other teams are sound really cool too!>

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
Next is our headliner!
Give it up for Vivid BAD SQUAD!

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line:
<Oh wow...!
This is the loudest the crowd's been so far!>

rows.Speaker: Len's Voice
rows.Line: <It's like they were all waiting for them!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Th-That was so cool! They were amazing!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah! This is so different from what happens during practice...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <The crowd looks like they're really having fun too!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah! Hey, why don't we try copying them?!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Huh? Are you sure?
Akito said not to mess around...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<C'mon, we'll be fine.
Everyone else is doing it♪>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yeah, this is do much fun!
I'm so glad they let us come and watch!>

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: Hm? I thought I just heard someone's voice just now... Coming from over there, maybe?

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: What? It's all just spare amps and speakers over there. They aren't even plugged in so, there's no way they could've made a sound.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <That was close, but let's keep that a secret.>
